subject: Disability Awareness Curriculum Pilot
overview: The subcommittee reviewed a plan to incorporate disability awareness into daily district instruction through a staff training course and spring classroom pilot. The committee approved a motion directing that funding for the initiative be included as a line item in the special education budget proposal.

items.title: Disability Awareness Curriculum and Pilot Program Presentation
items.summary: Medford CPAC representatives and district staff presented a proposal to integrate disability awareness into daily instruction across grades, beginning with a professional development course in January 2021 and a classroom pilot from March to May 2021.

items.title: Pilot Program Budget and Reporting Motion
items.summary: The committee approved a motion to receive an update on the pilot program prior to June and to include a specific funding line item for the curriculum work within the upcoming special education budget request.
